messages.subject: dplyr and numcolwise equivalent
parts:
Recently installed dplyr to try and improve performance on some tasks.  As a working example from plyr, I have something similar to

>df <- data.frame( label=sample( letters[1:10], 1000, replace=T), x = rnorm( 1000 ), y=sample( 1:20, 1000, replace=T))
>ddply( df, .(label), numcolwise( sum, na.rm=T ))
         x    y
1      a   1.4516582 1230
2      b  -0.2766902 1045
3      c   5.2963909  839
4      d  -6.7549779  951
5      e   7.1039250 1109
6      f  -9.1912472  907
7      g -14.3838711  906
8      h  12.6937375 1173
9      i  -7.3873968 1153
10     j  13.9534139 1026


Which works exactly as expected.  It's not clear to me how to achieve the same results using dplyr.  Help is appreciated.

robbie
